text:
Registering a newborn
The AIC website says ‘You do not need an appointment to register your newborn at PIBA.’ We are at PIBA now (Tel Aviv) and they say you definitely do need an appointment to register a newborn. Just in case this is relevant for anyone.

Adding to this: The clerk said that at the meeting they will take our documents but our baby will not receive a TZ number on the spot because a committee needs to decide whether to approve it or not. He was unable to tell us how long it will take for a decision to be made. It seems like either theyre messing with us or the procedure has changed.

Lior Beres
